## Checklist

- [ ] One mod, in its own folder: `mods/<your-mod>/mod.json` and `mods/<your-mod>/README.md`
- [ ] I played it, or ran it through **Test it in the Balance Lab**, at least once
- [ ] Nothing in it is taken from another game: no names, rules, rosters or text
- [ ] I ran `npm run catalogue` (or I'm happy for a maintainer to)
- [ ] **This mod is my own original work, and I dedicate it to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).**
